snippet.title: Precursors: Armored Angels | Trailer 4k
snippet.description:
Armored Angels is a turn-based strategy game in which players struggle with intelligent machines, competitive corporations and time. Deal with the invention of new technologies and the construction of huge walking units that allow you to counter the scale of the threat.


RELEASE DATE:
Dec 2021
